title: 붙여넣기 원문 사전 분석

crossYearFixture.description: Same exact text within selected year reuses analysis across target weeks; previous year never shares. Prepared draft/application keys remain fullweek.

persistenceOverride: Successful shared Claude item matching is versioned by exact raw source text and selected OrderYear, with no expiry. Target week changes within a year reuse this analysis because parse-paste receives selectedOrderYear only. Prepared client keys and ERP application locks remain full YYYY-WW-SS. Migrate newest valid legacy fullweek shared/actor result of same year and exact source, preserving savedAt and author, using exclusive publication. Explicit successful force replaces atomically; failure preserves last success. Durable memory results survive TTL and restoration outage. Cross-year reuse prohibited; no ERP writes. Legacy indexing is deduplicated per directory and cached for 30 seconds. Durable page memory refreshes shared saved results after 15 minutes and preserves its last success on failed/missing lookup; no automatic reanalysis of a saved match.
savedReadPriority: Read-only hydration restores exact-source same-year successful shared matching independently of viewport, automatic toggle and saving state. Client prepared keys remain selected fullweek. Durable page-memory success survives TTL and network outage; explicit failed reanalysis preserves prior success. A miss never consumes model budget or joins the model queue. Existing ERP baselines/mappings are reread on explicit draft opening.
automaticFailureBudget: Reserve new automatic attempts before network invocation, including failed attempts. Refund only a confirmed saved cache hit. Read-only lookup and explicit user analysis remain available beyond automatic budget.

criteria.cache: Page-local durable saved successes have no display TTL; 15 minute shared-result refresh falls back to last saved success on outage/miss. Transient results retain 15 minute TTL; max100 completed entries; cloned results and deduplicated pending calls.
criteria.automatic: one sequential call, max20 automatic calls per page lifetime; near-viewport actionable rows only while visible/online and not saving
criteria.manual: Exact-source same-year saved successful matching has no display TTL; prepared client drafts and application locks remain fullweek. Temporary unsaved analyses keep 15 minute TTL. All first analyses use authenticated persistent preparation. Current ERP/mapping reads still occur on opening.
criteria.application: matched is advisory, not committed; application audit remains separate
criteria.sideEffects: existing authenticated parse-paste API only: ERP SELECT and LLM usage accounting; no write/lease/confirmation APIs from automatic preparation

workspacePersistence: Same browser actor from authenticated auth/me + canonical YYYY-WW-SS draft: raw/exclusions/manual matching/evidence/base-remain inputs/verified historic completion retained without TTL. Never persist leases,tokens,presence,live order/stock baselines or saving. Completion locks require exact input/intent fingerprint, successful verified rows and same actor/fullweek. Reopening the identical completed input does not release the delta-write lock. Changing scope never inherits completion. Restored current ERP values are GET again; no replay.
